Offroad_TemperatureTooHigh.text: Device temperature too high. Cooling down before starting. Current temperature: %1.

Offroad_ConnectivityNeededPrompt.text: Connect to the internet to check for updates. openpilot won't engage in %1 if it can't connect.
Offroad_ConnectivityNeededPrompt._comment: Set extra field to number of days

Offroad_ConnectivityNeeded.text: Connect to the internet to check for updates. openpilot won't start until it can check for updates.

Offroad_UpdateFailed._comment: Set extra field to the failed reason.

Offroad_ChestnutBranch.text: Chestnut detected! Switch to the nightly-chestnut branch to use chestnut-class models.

Offroad_ChestnutModelError.text: Chestnut model error. Restart the car to retry.

Offroad_ChestnutNotDetected.text: Chestnut not detected. Check USB and 12V connections, then restart the car.

Offroad_ChestnutUpdateFailed.text: Chestnut update failed. Check the USB cable.

Offroad_ChestnutUsbSlow.text: Chestnut USB link is slow. Check the USB cable. The current speed is %1.

Offroad_UnregisteredHardware.text: Failed to register with comma.ai. This device won't connect or upload to comma.ai and isn't eligible for support. If you bought it at comma.ai/shop, open a ticket at comma.ai/support.

Offroad_UploadsIgnored.text: Uploads ignored due to a potential detected safety policy violation. Contact comma.ai/support if you believe this was made in error.

Offroad_CarUnrecognized.text: Car not recognized. It's either unsupported or its firmware isn't in openpilot yet. Get help at discord.comma.ai.

Offroad_Recalibration.text: Device mount position changed. Ensure the device is fully seated in the mount and the mount is firmly secured to the windshield.

Offroad_DriverMonitoringUncertain.text: Poor driver monitoring visibility. Ensure the device has a clear view of the driver, which you can check in the device settings. Extreme lighting or unusual mounting can also cause this.

Offroad_ExcessiveActuation.text: Excessive %1 actuation detected on your last drive. Contact comma.ai/support and share your Dongle ID.
Offroad_ExcessiveActuation._comment: Set extra field to lateral or longitudinal.

Offroad_Pairing.text: Finish setup. Pair your device with comma connect to view recent drives and bookmarked routes.
